dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: Exhausting, isn't it? The fear and pain brought on by the Wild Hunt builds up over repeated battles.

dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: Despair, sorrow... The shadows that lurk in your heart are seeds of malice it has planted.

dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: Let the moonlight and waves wash the darkness away. And after the sea has cleansed you, you shall be renewed.

dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: You must be new here, eh? Nah, the ceremony isn't mandatory.

dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: The war with the Wild Hunt visits long-lasting torment upon those who fight it. Some find no relief even in dreams. Some grow fearful of battle.

dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: You will feel like its shadow wraps around you, clings to you. That you cannot get free.

dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: I, too, went through this. And it was a senior Lightkeeper who helped me in that dark hour.

dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: It was he who taught me to wash my thoughts in the sea and the moon's glow, such that I would no longer fear.

dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: Many of us have suffered as I did in the past, and we gather here regularly to perform the Seabath Ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: Many of us recover much of ourselves after being soaked in seawater.

dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: It brings me joy to be able to help my comrades in this way.

dialogues.speaker: Ritual-Conducting Phantom
dialogues.text: May the waves and the moonlight sweep the darkness around us away, leaving only light and hope.
